ack_time.description: The time at which the member acknowledged the message thread.

group.description: The id of the group referenced by this thread member. Should only ever be one of either a user or group set for the thread member.

status.description: Whether this member has acknowledged the message thread.

thread.description: The id of the thread this thread member is a member of.

user.description: The id of the user referenced by this thread member. Should only ever be one of either a user or group set for the thread member.
